purpose: Test whether ambiguous octave-layer pairing and clamped out-of-action target labels damaged the training signal for the conservative register router.

frozenParameters.validation: complete-song leave-one-out over five non-WANE songs

comparisons.purpose: Keep onset pairing and remove false success labels caused by clamping three-octave errors to two octaves.
Protect existing exact-key matches before assigning the remaining pitch-class octave labels.

predeclaredContextFollowUp.hypothesis: The same register requires different corrections for bass, harmony, melody, and source families. Explicit role-by-register interactions allow different slopes rather than only family-specific intercepts.

requiredFollowUp: A safe cross-song label-policy result must still improve actual whole-song output under the unchanged scorer, including a separate WANE transfer check. Label counts or easier paired populations alone are not a model improvement.
interpretation: Research-only. No foundation weights or production arranger profile are changed by this test.
